purpose: Real external file changes, protected reload, native close/restart and ordinary-document neighbor navigation; Moye feature evidence, not original-application differential certification.

results.name: real external prepends restore the same reading paragraph and reload resets obsolete undo history
clean source reload preserves SV mode and the existing viewport when external text is appended below it
canceling dirty external reload leaves local source, reverse selection and undo intact
real deletion and rename disable reload while Save As preserves the in-memory document
ignoring or reloading one external change does not suppress the next actual disk change
invalid UTF8 and oversized external files report reload errors without replacing the loaded source
native app.quit flushes normal window bounds before exit and a full restart restores them
headless native fullscreen flags never replace the persisted normal size or reopen fullscreen
ordinary native document neighbors use natural Markdown order without a chosen workspace or TXT mixing
TXT native navigation stays in its own group and forged or stale neighbor capabilities cannot replace content

limitations: One headless host. Synthetic native window flag/geometry checks do not certify physical fullscreen, multi-display hardware, touch or OS input methods.

The native fullscreen API did not enter fullscreen on this headless host. Only normal-size persistence and non-fullscreen reopening were observed; actual fullscreen-size substitution remains for native-host validation.
